title: feat(studio): flow node and list-view panels lead with labels; node delete moves to the title-bar menu; nav kinds read in words
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBA6p6wR5XRGmnECFZqr87FM)_

Fixes #34796
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 的流程节点面板先显示「标签」,节点 ID 收进默认折叠的「开发者信息」;「删除节点」从面板底部移到标题栏「···」菜单;面板里的对象一律显示名称(如「会议」),不再露出内部名;「CEL 表达式」改称「公式」;新建自动化对话框第一项改为「自动化名称」;列表视图面板去掉 `对象.视图` 内部名,未创建提示缩成一句「改动先存为草稿。」,列行只显示字段名称、内部名放到悬停提示;导航编辑模式的类型标签改成与左侧列表一致的中文(对象 / 视图 / 仪表盘 / 页面)。
- 为什么改:这些面板是业务人员日常用的,内部名、ID 和 CEL 术语对他们没有意义,还挤占首屏。
- 风险与回滚:只改界面文字与布局,不改元数据、不改保存内容;删除逻辑不变(菜单项与画布 Delete 键走同一处理,都不弹确认,引用中的节点照样拒删)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowNodeInspector.tsx`(删除按钮移入菜单、开发者信息折叠)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/_shared.tsx`(菜单经 portal 画进宿主标题栏)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectPicker.tsx`(对象名称一次读取、按需读取)。
- 两分钟验证:在 Studio 打开任一记录触发的自动化,点画布上的「更新记录」节点:右侧第一项是「标签」,对象显示「会议」这类名称,标题栏右侧有「···」,里面是「删除节点」;展开底部「开发者信息」才看到 `node_1`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地

## What changes

All seven items of the card, in the Studio (`/studio/...`) surfaces; Setup's designers are byte-identical in behaviour.

1. **Node panel leads with Label.** `FlowNodeInspector` drops the top-of-panel ID field; the ID (and the nested-node hint) now sits in a `details` section "Developer info" / 「开发者信息」 that starts closed, at the end of the panel.
2. **Labels, not machine names, and "formula".** A new `ObjectLabelsProvider` (in `ObjectPicker.tsx`) wraps the node panel and lends object labels to `useObjectDisplayName`, used by the "Targets / Updates the “{object}” record…" and "Fields of “{object}”." sentences. It reads the object catalog once per panel, and only after a sentence that names an object mounts (a panel naming no object reads nothing). `ObjectPicker` gains an opt-in `nameOnHover` (used by `FlowReferenceField`): no visible name line, machine name on the input's `title`. Studio-namespace values: `kv.asExpression` 写成公式 / "Write as a formula", `kv.expressionNeeded` (the blank-formula notice) 这个值需要一个公式… / "This value needs a formula…", the expression and recipient placeholders, and the zh flow-field help table (`metadata-admin/i18n.ts`) for the trigger, Decision (branch help, the `expression` column and its help, legacy `condition`), record, loop, map, HTTP, action, screen, subflow and notify rows say 公式; the Update Records filter help no longer names `recordId`; the zh Update Records `multi` row is added (it showed English). The 「了解更多」 link is untouched.
3. **Remove node in the title-bar "···" menu, no confirmation.** The footer `InspectorRemoveButton` is gone; `headerActions` carries a `DropdownMenu` whose item calls the same `remove` handler. `InspectorShellHost` gains `headerActionsTarget`; in hosted mode the shell portals `headerActions` into it. `AutomationsPillar` hands the aside's `StudioInspector` an `actions` slot element and passes it as that target, so the menu sits in the automation panel's title bar. Read-only disables the trigger. The canvas Delete key is unchanged.
4. **New automation dialog**: `engine.studio.auto.nameLabel` 自动化名称 / "Automation name".
5. **List-view panel**: the `list-view-name` (`object.view`) line is removed (the view id stays on the root as `data-view-id`); `listView.notCreated` is 改动先存为草稿。 / "Changes save as a draft first."
6. **Column rows name on hover (Studio only)**: `ViewColumnPanes.FieldListRow` takes `nameOnHover` (prop, else the new `FieldListRowNameOnHover` context, default false); `ObjectListViewInspector` provides `true`. Setup provides nothing, so its rows still show the `code` name.
7. **Nav edit-mode kinds**: `AppNavCanvas` takes an optional `kindLabel`; Studio passes `navKindName` (the same words the navigation list tags entries with), so a kanban entry reads 视图. Setup passes nothing and keeps the raw type.

New `studio`-namespace keys (lazy namespace only): `engine.inspector.flowNode.moreActions`, `engine.inspector.flowNode.developerInfo`. `engine.inspector.action.target.flow.label` (「流程名称」, the action-target surface) is **not** touched. en strings are rewritten in the same plain spirit.

<details><summary>Before / after (live, zh-CN, 1280×800, self-built app 会议纪要, object 会议 = huiyi_jiyao_huiyi)</summary>

| Acceptance line | Before (round 1, main @ c513d62) | After (this branch) |
|---|---|---|
| Node panel first field | `ID` first (`ID, 标签, 节点类型…`) | first label `标签`; labels `标签, 节点类型, 对象*, 筛选` |
| Node ID in visible text | `node_1` in an always-visible field | `details` closed; id input `checkVisibility()` false, panel `innerText` has no `node_1`; after expanding: visible |
| Internal object name | `huiyi_jiyao_huiyi` under the picker, in 「目标为启动此流程的那条 huiyi_jiyao_huiyi 记录。」 and 「huiyi_jiyao_huiyi 的字段。」 | no `huiyi_jiyao_huiyi` in panel text; picker value 会议, `title` huiyi_jiyao_huiyi; 「目标为启动此流程的那条「会议」记录。」, 「「会议」的字段。」 |
| CEL wording | 「写成 CEL 表达式」; filter help 「或 CEL 表达式(如 id → 以表达式写的 recordId)」 | toggle 「写成公式」; 「每个值是字面量,或公式(如 id 一栏用公式指向触发记录)。」; no `CEL`/`recordId` in panel text |
| Update every matching record (zh) | English | 「更新所有匹配的记录」 + zh help |
| Delete node | full-width footer 「删除节点」 | no footer button; title-bar `···` (inside `auto-config-header-actions`) → menu `["删除节点"]` → node removed, no confirm dialog |
| Canvas Delete key (control) | removes node | removes node, no confirm dialog |
| New automation dialog | labels `["流程名称", …]` | labels `["自动化名称","标识",…]`, title 新建自动化 |
| List-view panel | `huiyi_jiyao_huiyi.default` line; long not-created paragraph | no `object.view` text (`data-view-id` attribute only); 「改动先存为草稿。」 |
| Column rows | label + `code` name | 名称 only, `title="name"`, 0 `code` elements |
| Nav edit badges | `object` | object entry 对象; type switched to page → 页面, dashboard → 仪表盘 (left list shows the same words) |
| Nav kanban entry → 视图 | — | NOT MEASURED live: the self-built app has no named (kanban) view to point an entry at; pinned by `InterfacesNavRail.editKinds-34796.test.tsx` |

Backend for the live stack ran from `dist/` built at the round-1 base (UI served from this branch's source by vite dev); none of the readings depend on the backend changes merged since.
</details>

## Tests

New:
- `inspectors/FlowNodeInspector.labelFirst-34796.test.tsx` (6): Label first + closed Developer info holding the id; object by label with picker hover title; menu remove patch equals `edgesAfterNodeRemoval` and clears selection; read-only trigger disabled, no menu item; **control** canvas Delete key makes the same removal; hosted portal into the host title-bar element.
- `studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.namesOnHover-34796.test.tsx` (2): Studio rows label-only with `title`; **control** `FieldListRow` without provider keeps the `code` name.
- `studio-design/InterfacesNavRail.editKinds-34796.test.tsx` (3): zh object / view (kanban) / dashboard / page read 对象 / 视图 / 仪表盘 / 页面; en; **control** without `kindLabel` the raw type.

Updated (wording or the menu, behaviour unchanged): `FlowNodeInspector.test`, `.readOnlyReason-28985`, `.removeEdges-11772`, `.removeRefusal-11838`, `.connectorInputEnvelope-28164`, `.fieldValueMap-11788`, `.updateRecordTarget-27834`, `ResourceEditPage.inspectorReadOnlyReason-29079`, `FlowPreview.removeNode-11772`, `FlowPreview.nodeIdPositions-11838`, `FlowKeyValueField.valueEnvelope`, `.stackedRows-27356`, `FlowRecipientsField.test`, `flowValueSlots-12101`, `flowValueSlots-12372`, `inspectorStrings.i18n-10586`, `AutomationsPillar.problemsAgree-27799`, `InterfacesPillar.offNavListViews-30046`, `StudioDesignSurface.listViewSwitch-27896`, `StudioDesignSurface.listViewInspector-11823`, `ObjectListViewInspector.addView-27836`, `ObjectListViewInspector.displayTitle-13151`. Edited tests also import `@objectstack/lint` (and `@objectstack/formula` where reached) at module top, as `check:test-source-alias` asks.

<details><summary>Ablations (each red, then restored; git diff HEAD empty after)</summary>

Run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1→0, restore blob == HEAD) under `os-verify-lock`:

| Mutation | Red test |
|---|---|
| menu item `onSelect={remove}` → no-op | menu item makes the removal the footer made |
| `details` → `details open` | id only inside a collapsed Developer info |
| picker `title` → undefined | machine name on the picker hover title only |
| `useObjectDisplayName` returns the name | object by its label |
| hosted portal branch off | menu drawn into the host title-bar element |
| `FieldListRowNameOnHover` provider `false` | a row reads its label alone |
| `kindText = kind` | zh kinds + en kinds (2 red) |

Final: `=== git diff HEAD (must be empty):` printed nothing; lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Still saying CEL outside this card's panels: the edge inspector's `engine.inspector.flowEdge.conditionHint` (「CEL 表达式 —— 为真时走此连线」), the condition builder's `engine.condition.celLabel`, and the list-view panel's conditional-formatting empty state (「添加一条以按 CEL 条件为行着色」). The engine-served en help for flow node fields (service-automation `configSchema`) and the en flow-node-config table are not reworded here.
- Field-key suggestion lists in key/value rows still show `label (name)`.
- The nav item inspector (`StudioNavItemInspector`) still prints the entry id (`nav_item_2`) under its title; not in this card.
- Item 6 uses a context (`FieldListRowNameOnHover`) so `FieldsListEditor.tsx`, outside the amended claim, is untouched.
